_comment: Context Management block. Segments grouped across 3 lines for readability: (1) directory + git, (2) model + session (context is disabled here — statusline-gsd.sh renders the usage gauge in its place), (3) agent. See display.lines. NOTE: claude-powerline.json is strict JSON — `//` comments break it and silently fall back to defaults; use `_comment` keys (ignored by the parser) instead.

segments._comment_today: today (daily $ cost) intentionally hidden — not used right now. To bring it back set today.enabled=true; the segment and its color are kept here for future use.
segments._comment_context: context segment disabled here — statusline-gsd.sh renders a 3-zone (green→amber→red) usage gauge in its place, fed by context_window.used_percentage. Re-enable here only if you drop the script gauge.
